items.name: subscription-state
items.title: Subscription state
items.description: One function that turns a Stripe subscription into the product decision: needs card, trialing, cancelling but still running, paused, past due, or ended. Scheduled cancellations keep access until Stripe ends them.
items.author: PumpGTM (https://pumpgtm.com)

items.name: cancel-flow
items.title: Cancel flow
items.description: An in-app Stripe cancel dialog: a reason with one follow-up question, then a full refund if they were charged in the last 24 hours, or one save offer picked from the reason (more trial days, a pause, a discount, a free month, or this month forgiven when a payment failed), then a real cancellation. Past-due cancels void what is owed. Records everything on Stripe, so there is no table to add.
items.author: PumpGTM (https://pumpgtm.com)
